examples.name: Business Starter Kit
examples.audience: New founders and small early-stage businesses with their business facts and positioning ready.
examples.summary: Bring your service descriptions, first inquiry steps and business direction into one practical starter kit.
examples.delivery: Joint delivery, with a defined lead and reviewer in the project scope.
deliverables: One inquiry form of up to ten questions and one reply template
One page of audience, positioning and tone direction
One consolidated revision and a 30-minute handoff
limits: Website builds, logos and visual identity are separate
No ongoing social management, business filings, accounting, insurance or funding applications
No guaranteed revenue, employment, funding, rankings or regulatory compliance
inputs: Your existing business facts and positioning
Client-owned or licensed materials and one decision maker
examples.handoff: Review each agreed item, record written sign-off and receive the files in the agreed client-owned folder.

examples.name: Operations Setup
examples.audience: Small service businesses organizing one manual inquiry, booking and follow-up workflow.
examples.summary: Map a customer workflow and organize the templates and tracking steps that support it.
examples.delivery: Joint delivery, with a defined lead and reviewer in the project scope.
deliverables: Scheduling guidance in your existing tool
CRM stage and field guidance or a simple tracker
One consolidated revision and a 45-minute handoff
limits: No software purchases, custom development or bulk migration
Ongoing inbox management and regulated advice are outside this scope
No guaranteed revenue, employment, funding, rankings or regulatory compliance
inputs: Your current workflow and an existing approved tool
Client-owned or licensed materials and permission for agreed system access
One client decision maker to review the workflow
examples.handoff: Review the agreed files, test one inquiry through the scoped workflow and record written sign-off before handoff.
